evidence: Read task/instruction.md cold (17 lines, 7 prose paragraphs, no headings, no numbered or bulleted lists, no tables, no 'shall'). It opens as a first-person ask from a recruiting team: line 1 'Can you build HireOps, the workspace our recruiting team lives in all day? ... Several of us have it open at once, so the hard part is that nobody's work gets trampled when someone else acts.' Behaviour is expressed as user needs, not acceptance criteria: line 3 'I often move several candidates together; that has to be all of them or none, and I need to be able to undo my last move'; line 5 'without closing the card I have open, wiping the note I am typing or moving my cursor'; line 7 'If a message arrives while I am reading further up, leave my place alone and just tell me there is something new'. Design freedom is explicit: line 11 'layout and names are yours'; line 13 'How you lay the other files and routes out under /app is your call.' Build-recipe check: line 13 names Node.js/Express/SQLite, the start command, port, PORT, GET /api/health, /app/app.db and DB_PATH, but these are the hard runtime facts the verifier needs (workbook row #4 requires them to be stated) and the template's shared runtime (integration.md:3-10), not a file layout or endpoint list; the only route named is the health check. Line 17 lists demo accounts inline as a sentence, which the skill lists as an expected credential, not a defect. The detailed stage/permission/conversation spec (tables, bullets, 401/403/404/409 codes) lives in /instructions/hireops_rules.md, which the brief references in natural language at line 11 ('The exact stage rules, who may do what, and the conversation rules are in /instructions/hireops_rules.md'); the skill's check 2 anticipates terse notes alongside the brief, so a structured rules note does not make the prompt itself a spec sheet. Template instruction.md is only a CHANGE_ME placeholder, so the task-authored text is fully replaced (no residue). Counterexample attempts: (a) a broken app could not pass by exploiting this row, since it concerns prompt wording only; (b) a conforming alternative is not penalised by the wording, since files, routes, names and layout are expressly left open. Residual observation (not a defect for this row): the runtime paragraph at line 13 and the account list at line 17 are denser and more contract-like than the rest, and hireops_rules.md is long and normative ('Follow them exactly', line 3); whether that note's voice is consistent is for row 2 and fairness/coverage for rows 4/6, not this row. No runtime evidence is required for this source-wording row; no Oracle, model or portal score is claimed.
